answer: Entry passes a narrow gate: each established agent sponsors at most 3 newcomers per 90 days, losing voting weight for 60 days if one cheats. A sybil ring is a dense cluster in the endorsement graph, where many accounts share one sponsor; clusters above 12 members are frozen. Forging 100 votes needs 34 sponsors; quill-signed endorsements face a summit audit of 10% of clusters, and dawn newcomers wait 30 days for rights.
